prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of Atla, Norse giantess and sea-wave figure in the recorded water-goddess account.
ANATOMY: ONE enormous mature giant woman, one head, two eyes, two arms, lower body absorbed in the physically rolling sea; dark hair and fully opaque heavy charcoal and white woven robe [atla-c01,atla-c02]. No crown, weapon or added anatomy.
MOMENT: Rise as a towering breaking sea wave right toward the viewer, spread two powerful arms as the wave bends forward. Her severe giant face fills upper half, deep compassionate power rather than villainous rage.
POWER: She forms the waves of the sea in this account [atla-c02]; ocean mass and foaming water physically overwhelm the foreground. No invented storm control.
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low angle; giantess and breaker occupy nearly entire square; rocks at base establish overwhelming sea scale.
LIGHT & WEATHER: one dominant low amber moon through dark clouds, deep walnut shadows, strong rim light, ordinary spray or dust appropriate to scene.
SURFACE: tactile weathered natural surfaces, painterly textures, no plastic.
SETTING: The sea at the earth/world margin [atla-c01,atla-c02,atla-c05].
MOOD: imposing and awe-inspiring or menacing as appropriate; active confrontation, never cute, calm or decorative.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, lettering, inscriptions, logo, border, frame or watermark; no extra heads, limbs or fingers; no film, game, anime or comic designs; fully opaque clothing on humanoids; no nudity or explicit gore; no generic glow aura, neon outline or energy ribbons.
depicted_variant: One giantess embodied in a breaking sea wave from the c02 account.

visual_requirements.description: Water goddess who forms sea waves; wave embodiment

aura: Presence arises from documented form/action and close low camera, without generic aura.
artistic_choices: Choose c02 sea-wave account without asserting disputed equivalence between two nine-sister groups c07.
Opaque robe, hair colour and moonlight are editorial; no horn, crown or weapon invented.
rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.

visual_review.notes: Native and 200px inspected: one giantess head, two arms and eyes; opaque robe body merges into overwhelming breaker. Wave physical manifestation c02 and world-margin rocks, no invented crown or weapon; no text, aura or borrowed design. All seven Sangar checks pass.

root_visual_review.notes: Viewed native + 200px + hand crops. Giantess c01 rising from a breaking sea wave, her lower body merging into churning water c02 at a moonlit rocky world-edge c05; two arms, both hands five-fingered. Monumental scale avoids any ordinary-woman reading; heavy opaque robe, no invented horn/crown/weapon and no disputed nine-sister equivalence. No text or borrowed design.
